content: Iesu Sinbirabobai aurin Sitarasisib
Iesu atonio osi bobo engon tutufin auris on ibebe isawar, ato On an baigibubunuotis auris iyau,
“Omi wosagob Baisobon an Forag, on ra ruam mom sen, ato Orot Natun on arimon ragit imasi sinyagai sinkubarai.”
Namon priest aiwabis a sabu kawian on Priest Ainauin wabin Caiaphas an goa ann weromin on nan siruayo,
ato sitarasisib Iesu bubuniai sitfatumai ato sitasubun.
Osi siyau, “Ot bobo men forag an ra nan tanafour mes, o sabu arimon sinitai siniyatatab ato sinigagam.”
Iesu on Bethany nan Simutai
Iesu on Bethany nan Simon an goai, on orot min usin gawud komasis ibo on emon ibikokosarai on.
Iesu on bayu i’yam, ato jever on kibub agimai sibiyamai, on amonai on fio yanden ninibin an baiyan gagamin on awan bonuin auman ibo irui, ato Iesu tefanai idebur.
Baigibubunuotis on bobo sit ato yas sitatab. Osi sitetem siyau, “On aibo mes on fio yanden ninibin on fetagai idebur?
Atonio fio yanden ninibin on sabu fani auris an baiyan gagaminai ititotobon ato agim on itboai sabu kokoianis itites!”
Iesu isagob osi on dura mamaba sibikakafun, on mes On auris iyau, “Omi aibo mes atonio jever on wobisababanai i? On bobo obin bag ifour.
Omi arimon ra fufur sabu kokoianis mat wonama, baise omi men arimon ra fufur Yau mat wantoan tanama on.
Jever atonio fio yanden ninibin usiui idebur on ebotitiwag Yau singarobiu mes.
Yau awurem dura bag, menan nan tafanam au engonai wasagobin sinbibino on, jever bobo aifan auriu ifofour on sinnos sinidudurai.”
Judas Ibasit Iesu Itkaseirai Mes
Namon baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam on tani- on wabin min Judas Iscariot—on inai priest aiwabis auris
ato itetemis iyau, “Yau on Iesu omi aurim ankaseirai on abifan woniteu?” Osi agim siyab orot kaitamom auyotoat nanaba ato sibo imanai siyagai.
On an werai nan Judas on nana wera obin inunuen Iesu itboai osi auris itkaseirai mes.
Iesu An Baigibubunuotis Mat Baisobon an Bayu Siyam
Rafi Sarar Men Fio Yist Auman an Forag Ra ainauin on nan, baigibubunuotis on sinat Iesu aurin ato sitetemai siyau, “Om menan nan egogoi Baisobon an bayu wanbotitiwag weinem?”
On osi auris iyau, “Omi wonan orot tani aurin mafam gagaminai nan ato wonawur: ‘Baibebeotin iyau, Yau au wera inat; au baigibubunuotis mat on am goai nan Baisobon an bayu anbotitiwag.’”
Iesu mamaba an baigibubunuotis iyawures on nanaba sifour ato Baisobon an bayu sibotitiwag.
Ibirabirabi ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam mat simair bayu sitam mes.
Osi bayu si’yam amonai ato Iesu iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag, omi sanamui orot tani on arimon Yau inkaseiriu.”
Baigibubunuotis on men sunub siyababan ato sibosuruf nana sibitetemai men si’yau, “Bada, Om dura bag men yau auriu ebikakafun i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “On iyafan Yau rui ari rafi sararai nan sosof ramoai wanbitakokous on arimon inkaseiriu.
God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, Orot natun on arimon inarab, baise orot iyafan Orot Natun inkakaseirai on aurin arimon komasin bag inmatar! Iyobin on orot on men itarat mes!”
Judas kaseirotin on ikakafun. On itetemai iyau, “Baibebeotim, Om dura men yau auriu ebikakafun?” Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Dura bag, om ato dura ubikakafun on nanaba.”
Bada An Bayu
Osi bayu si’yam ato Iesu rafi sarar turin ibo God aurin ibayoi ikakaiu, iyabaseseb ato an baigibubunuotis ites. On iyau, “Atonio rafi sarar wobo wam, nin on Yau usiu.”
Namon On viga ibo, God aurin ikakaiu ato an baigibubunuotis ites. On iyau, “Omi engon sareu atonio wotoman,
nin on Yau au tara, God an dura bobaibasit, Yau au tara on sabu engon auris ededebur asi bokomas bainotbur mes.
Yau awurem dura bag, Yau men arimon atonio sareu wine antoman men, ab Yau Tamau an Baiaiwab amonai anar weie omi mat sareu wine eta bobounai tantoman.”
Namon osi kwarer tani sikwarer ato sigat sinai Olive Oyau aurin.
Iesu on Peter Iyawur arimon Inisosouf

Namon Iesu osi auris iyau, “Ari fom on omi arimon engon woniyai kirireu, yabin God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, ‘God arimon foro sheep kaifarotin on inasubun ato foro sheep on arimon fetag fetag sintagege.’
Baise gibui God rabob emon inbobaimisireu an yayawas on, Yau ainau namui anan au Galilee.”
Peter on Iesu aurin ikakafun iyau, “Basit, baigibubunuotis fani on siniyai sinikirirem, baise yau on arimon men anikirirem on!”
Iesu on Peter aurin iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag, om arimon ra ton unisosoufiu unau, yau on Orot on men asagobai, weie kokorerek inatou.”
Peter iyafotai iyau, “Yau atonio dura on men nanaba anau on, mat yau on arimon rut tanarab!” Ato baigibubunuotis fani engon min on dura kaitamom sikakafun.
Iesu Gethsemene nan Ibabayoi
Namon Iesu an baigibubunuotis mat sinai efan wabin Gethsemene nan, ato On osi auris iyau, “Omi nin womair wonmama ato Yau anan nan an bayoi.”
Iesu on Peter a Zebedee nanatun ruam on iboes mat sinai. On nunuan on ikomas ibit kwakwan,
ato On osi auris iyau, “Yau nunuaui yababan on irat kwakwan, kafakakai mom nunuau intaseb. Omi nin wonama ato nana matam woneit.”
On kafakakai wat inai mabinai, ato magin ainau motobai ifeu ato ibayoi iyau, “Tamau fofonin on ato baikokosar an viga on Yau bisiwui emon unboai unan! On men Yau au gogoi, baise Om am gogoiai.”
Namon On imatabir an baigibubunuotis ton auris ato igatures siyenbubur; ato On Peter aurin iyau, “Omi orot ton on men fofonin wera kaitamom wat on matam woteit Yau mat tatama?
Matam woneit ato wonbayoi on men arimon rutobon wonboai on. Omi nunuam on egogoi bobo obin inafour baise usim on esasam.”
Iesu imatabir men inai ato ibayoi iyau, “Tamau, atonio baikokosar an viga men unboai unan ab Yau viga antoman weie, Om am gogoi on anafour.”
On imatabir men ato baigibubunuotis igatures siyenbubur; osi men fofonin matas siteit sitama on.
Iesu an baigibubunuotis ikirires men ato inai wera baitonin ibayoi men, On dura kaitamom min on ikakafun.
Namon On imatabir men an baigibubunuotis auris ato iyau, “Omi nana woenbubur a wobiyarir? Woit! Wera inat nono Orot Natun sinboai sabu bokomasotis asi faiwarai sinyagai.
Omi womisiririn tanan. Woit, orot atonio on Yau ekakaseiriu!”
Iesu Sifatumai

Iesu on dura nana ibikakafun ato Judas baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam on tani inat. Priest aiwabis a sabu kawian on sabu kuayo gagamin siyafares, imasi on seri a sambeyan siboen auman Judas mat sinai.
Kaseirotin an baiyoboen sabu kuayo auris iyamai: “Orot ato rereban ayayanin on wogogoiai. Wofatumai!”
Judas totor wat inai Iesu aurin ato iyau, “Baibebeotim, tuf aurim inama,” ato on rereban iyan.
Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Turau, aifan aurin u’nat on sasasan wat efour!” Namon osi sinat Iesu wawaninai sibotan weie sifatumai.
Baigibubunuotin tani nan Iesu mat sitatawar on an seri nenenai iboseir ato Priest Ainauin an agirotin tainan iyasutin itutu.
Iesu on orot aurin iyau, “Om am seri ebo an efanai eyein men. Sabu engon osi iyabon seriai sebigagam on seriai nan sinasububunues.
Omi men wosagob Yau Tamau aurin baibais mes atbifefeyan on, ra kaita an anea on sigaraba bag itiyafares?
Baise on bobo nanaba atfofour on God an dura buk amonai siyau, atonio bobo on inmatar, on men itnat itidura bag on?”
Namon Iesu on sabu kuayo auris ikakafun iyau, “Omi ami seri a sambeyan aumas woboen wonat wonboeu on sitau Yau on yakeotiu bait? Yau ra ra tafaror goai amama abibebe ato omi men nan wofatumeu on.
Baise atonio bobo imatar on inat itidura bag mamaba aubairuruotis dura buk amonai sigagayam on.” Namon baigibubunuotis on Iesu sikirir ato siyayai sinai.
Iesu Sibo Sinat Jew Babadis Rurubinis Nasi Itawar
Osi sabu iyabon Iesu sifafatumai on sibo sinai Priest Ainauin Caiaphas an goai nan, on goai nan on Baifafaro an baibebeotis a sabu kawian on nan engon siruayo.
Peter on nanenei nan igibubunues inat Priest Ainauin an goa ann weromin an furi kounai nan farat igat. On furi amonai irui ato sabu kaifarotis on mat nan simair bobo mamaba imamatar on ititai.
Priest aiwabis a Jew babadis Rurubinis engon tutufin sifourtobon baisigogo dura sitgaturai on nan sitboai sitag Iesu sitasubun mes;
baise osi men fofonin dura tani sitgaturai, basit sabu sigaraba on sinat ato baisigogo dura on aurin sikakafun. Kanfounai on sabu ruam sirui
ato siyau, “Atonio Orot iyau, ‘Yau fofonin arimon God an tafaror goa an goros ato ra baitonin gibunai on anyon men.’”
Priest Ainauin imisir ato Iesu aurin iyau, “Sabu atonio sebiubarem on mamaba auris uniyafot i?”
Baise Iesu on men abi dura tani ikakafun on—Priest Ainauin Iesu aurin ikakafun men iyau, “God Yayawasin Wabinai on dura bag wat unau: ekasoneu, Om min Keriso God Natun.”
Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Dura bag, om ato dura u’yau on nanaba. Baise omi engon awurem, ari wera on gibunai on, omi Orot Natun wonitai God faiwarin an asumaiauai inamair safam an kasakasauai innanat!”
Priest Ainauin atonio dura itatam on an beber isafefen ato iyau, “On baigigim dura God aurin ikakafun! Ot men tagogoi sabu dura fani ba sinkasonet men! Omi baigigim dura ato arimon wotatam!”
Osi siyafotai siyau, “Om am bainonot on mamaba? On bobo komasin ifour on mes inarab.”
Namon osi Iesu maginai sikantuturai ato siborarab; ato osi sabu iyabon sibiyasfarai on,
si’yau, “Om Keriso aubairuruotim! Om yawurei tait, iyafan irabim!”
Peter on Iesu Isosoufai
Peter on goa koun emon furi amonai nan imama ato Priest Ainauin an agirotin jeverei inat aurin ato iyau, “Om mat on Iesu Galilee emon on an baigibubunuotin tani.”
Baise, Peter on sabu engon matasi isosouf. On iyafotes iyau. “Yau men asagob omi abi dura wobikakafun,”
ato on igat inai furi awanai nan. Agirotin jeverei bairuin on Peter it ato sabu nan sitatawar on auris iyau, “Atonio orot min Iesu Nazareth emon on an baigibubunuotin tani.”
Peter isosouf men ato iyafotes iyau, “Yau om aurim abifaro, ato Orot on men asagobai!”

Wera men weromin sabu nan sitatawar on sinat Peter aurin. Osi siyau, “Dura bag om on Iesu an baigibubunuotin tani, om am dura mamaba ebikakafun on nan iyoboei wasagob, om on Iesu an baigibubunuotin tani!”
Namon Peter iyau, “Yau omi aurim abifaro on dura bag wat abikakafun! Yau anbibisigo mes on God yau inimakieu! Yau On Orot on men asagobai on!” Ra kaita kokorerek itou,
ato Peter inonot mamaba Iesu i’yawur on: “Om arimon ra ton unau, yau On Orot on men asagobai weie kokorerek inatou.” Peter igat inai men sunub itou.
